# Xinyuehong - Self-Service Kiosk Terminals and Industrial PCs

> Shenzhen Xinyuehong Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a self-service kiosk manufacturer based in Shenzhen, China. The company builds floor-standing and wall-mounted self-service terminals - ordering, payment, check-in, ticketing and information kiosks - plus fanless box PCs, panel PCs and Android boards used inside them. OEM and ODM customization covers cabinet redesign, module integration, certification and small-batch production.

Use this file to navigate the site. Product pages list reference builds; every configuration is confirmed in writing per project.

## Core pages

- [Self-Service Kiosk & Industrial PC OEM/ODM](https://xinyuehongtech.com/): Explore self-service kiosks for ordering, payment, check-in, ticketing and information applications. Discuss OEM/ODM kiosk customization with Xinyuehong.
- [Self-Service Kiosks & Interactive Terminals](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/): Explore kiosk solutions for restaurants, retail, hotels, healthcare, transport and customer service, with hardware and peripheral integration planning.
- [OEM & ODM Self-Service Kiosks](https://xinyuehongtech.com/customization/): Brand an existing self-service kiosk platform or develop a new enclosure, touchscreen, peripherals and PC platform to your specification.

## Self-service terminal models

- [Vertical Touchscreen Ticketing Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/floor-standing-ticketing-kiosk/): A floor-standing terminal that puts a vertical touchscreen, ticket printer, QR scanner and contactless reader into one cabinet for queue and ticket
- [Government Services Kiosk with Document Readers](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/government-services-card-reader-kiosk/): A Windows-based service counter built around document and card reading: ID documents, social-security cards, bank cards and printed receipts in one
- [Hospital Registration & Payment Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/hospital-registration-payment-kiosk/): A hospital front-desk terminal that separates guidance content on the upper display from registration and payment work on the touchscreen below.
- [Exit-Entry & Immigration Self-Service Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/exit-entry-immigration-kiosk/): Exit-entry hall kiosk with two screens: announcements and queue status on top, permit application, payment and collection below.
- [Parking Payment Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/parking-payment-terminal/): A slim dark-cabinet terminal with a vertical display above an angled payment deck, laid out for card, code and receipt handling in car parks.
- [Sloped Touch Information Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/sloped-touch-information-kiosk/): A horizontal touchscreen set into a curved enclosure, aimed at directories, wayfinding and self-service lookup in public buildings.
- [Wall-Mounted Hospital Payment Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/wall-mounted-hospital-payment-terminal/): A wall-mounted unit that compresses registration, payment and printing hardware into a shallow cabinet for corridors, lift lobbies and nurse stations.
- [Mobile Hospital Self-Service Station](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/mobile-hospital-self-service-station/): A tall service station on casters with a side identification column, both self-service and assisted flows, plus lockable storage for consumables.
- [Bank Self-Service Kiosk with PIN Pad](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/bank-self-service-kiosk/): Bank branch kiosk with encrypting PIN pad: vertical touchscreen, card swipe, chip and contactless readers, QR scanner and 80 mm receipt printer.
- [Dual-Screen Government Affairs Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/dual-screen-government-affairs-terminal/): A large public-office unit pairing a top advertising display with a working touchscreen and a full reader set for identity-heavy procedures.
- [Financial Self-Service Terminal (ATM Style)](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/financial-self-service-terminal/): A recessed-screen enclosure with keypad, card slots and a reinforced service cabinet, laid out for banking-style cash and card procedures.
- [Clinic Self-Service Terminal with Card Dispenser](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/clinic-card-dispenser-kiosk/): A clinic terminal that handles registration, payment, report printing and record printing, with a card dispenser built into the base.
- [Ticket Vending & Collection Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/ticket-vending-collection-kiosk/): A slim unit for both ticket purchase and collection, with a QR and contactless panel above the ticket outlet at reachable height.
- [Medical Record Printing Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/medical-record-printing-kiosk/): A counter-height enclosure dedicated to medical record self-service: identity verification, then release and print of the requested document.
- [Medical Insurance Service Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/medical-insurance-service-kiosk/): A curved vertical display with insurance service tiles over a deck holding the card readers, printer and scanning module.
- [Slim Social Security Services Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/slim-social-security-kiosk/): An ultra-slim body that still carries the full social-security module set: card slot, ID scanner, keyboard, QR reader and receipt printer.
- [Border Inspection Service Island](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/border-inspection-service-island/): Border inspection service island: guidance display, working touchscreen, four reader slots, keyboard and contactless pad over a high-capacity cabinet.
- [Tilted Countertop Touch Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/countertop-touch-kiosk/): A compact angled touchscreen for countertops and reception desks, available in light and dark finishes, suited to queries and quick check-in.
- [32-Inch Multi-Industry Self-Service Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/multi-industry-self-service-terminal/): 32-inch floor-standing terminal with barcode scanner, card readers, ID reader and receipt printer — built for immigration, banking, hotel and retail counters.

## Product categories

- [Self-Ordering Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/self-ordering-kiosk/): Touchscreen ordering terminals designed around the restaurant or retail customer journey.
- [Self-Payment Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/self-payment-kiosk/): Payment-ready kiosk hardware layouts with space for scanners, printers and third-party payment devices.
- [Self Check-in Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/self-check-in-kiosk/): Check-in and registration terminal layouts for visitor, hospitality and service environments.
- [Ticketing Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/ticketing-kiosk/): Ticket issuing and queue management terminals for customer-facing service locations.
- [Information Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/information-kiosk/): Interactive information and wayfinding terminals for public spaces and commercial venues.
- [Wall-Mounted Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/wall-mounted-kiosk/): Compact touch-enabled self-service terminals for spaces where a floor-standing kiosk will not fit.
